best_idea: Guard the arm_neon.h include and NEON intrinsics with #if defined(__ARM_NEON) and add a scalar fallback so the file compiles on non-ARM hosts while keeping the fast NEON i-k-j kernel on Apple Silicon.

best_lineage.idea: Replace the scalar i-j-k loop with an i-k-j kernel: zero C once, stream contiguous rows of B and C, accumulate with NEON 4-wide FMA over j, and block the i dimension so each B row is reused from L1 across several C rows; sweep the i-block size.
